items.title: 66600_Teddy Wilson oral history interview
items.q: Not too close. I've made several record dates with him and some jam sessions and jazz concerts.

ctx.x: Did you know Bird much? Charlie?

Not too close. I've made several record dates with him and some jam sessions and jazz concerts. I remember once when I was down at WNEW, he came out a few times as guest with the house band, and they'd have some jazz sessions there.
